title: Scene Graph-based Driving Scenario Extraction for Automotive Egocentric Datasets
description:
arXiv:2609.00333v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Extracting scenarios from unlabelled real-world sensor data streams is a critical but challenging task in the development process of automated driving systems (ADS). Automatically sifting through large datasets to spatially and temporally locate critical scenarios can enable scenario-based coverage analysis of ADS datasets.
